description: Replace your plan: a goal, its steps in dependency order with statuses, and the assumptions and open questions behind it. Keep exactly one step in_progress while working.
name: update_plan

assumptions.description: Gaps you filled yourself, each with the value you chose

open_questions.description: Decisions that are the user's to make or cannot be researched

acceptance.description: The check that shows the step is done

depends_on.description: Titles of the steps that must finish first

owner.description: Who does the step: yourself, or a subagent and its tier

title.description: Unique within the plan; depends_on refers to it
